They charge you 1 coin per answer they give even when the same solution is involved. For example a 3 part system of equations question will use 3 coins ($6) to answer. When it is really one question they charge several times. I think it’s the individual because I’ve had some only charge once. I think the person gets paid per answer so they cheat that way. 

My biggest issue is that when the answers are incorrect they don’t refund my coins. Why am I paying the the WRONG answers? I could get them wrong for free. I would prefer they pass the question if they don’t know the answer. 

Also, they will constantly change the person solving the question if it takes too long to find a solution to restart their timer as it states that each question could be solved in a few minutes. A few minutes quickly turns into 45 mins. 

Mix all this together and you have a very frustrating day of math homework, quizzes, or tests. 

Tests are timed so getting an answer every 30 mins is not acceptable due to the fact that I’m paying for the subscription, the coins, and the priority and the priority still isn’t priority. 

Overall it’s okay. I haven’t found one better at solving word problems but there is work to be done. Especially taking paid coins for wrong answers.
